alignments.note: Anarthrous participle made substantival by a supplied He that (rule 46), headed on the word carrying the lexeme.
לְ before the infinitive takes the written to (rule 52).
Hiphil infinitive rendered as light verb plus complement; heads on the complement evil (rule 44).
Dative לְ recast as a bare English object; nothing is written for the relation (rule 40).
Suffix takes the object pronoun him.
בַּעַל rendered maker with the indefinite article the expression licenses; the chain is rendered attributively (rule 28).
Men is a lexical subject noun the ASV supplies for an impersonal plural verb; rule 17 leaves such a noun added, exactly as in men shall dwell therein.

review_notes: The competing reading for בַּעַל מְזִמּוֹת would fuse the pair under rule 30, but the ASV spends a word on each (mischief, maker), so rule 2 splits it.
